nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; controls onlyOwner restricted functions.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
ERC20 token symbol 'ZAR'.
ERC20 token name 'Zarina'.
Token decimals (8).
Total token supply, credited to the deployer-designated address.
Mapping of holder address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Overflow-checked addition helper from SafeMath.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper from SafeMath.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper from SafeMath.
Division-by-zero-checked helper from SafeMath.
Owned constructor; assigns deployer msg.sender as owner.
onlyOwner function staging a new owner into newOwner.
Second step of ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor; mints the full supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of a token holder.
Moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens.
Moves tokens from a third party, decrementing balances and allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets allowance then calls an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowances.
Raw (unchecked) subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied contract.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) on an attacker-supplied contract.

to argument of transfer.

edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership authorizes based on msg.sender == newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership compares msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership mutates newOwner, which gates acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership overwrites newOwner with address(0) after promotion.
Zarina constructor sets _totalSupply to a fixed value.
Zarina constructor credits the entire supply into balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] inside an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply performs an unchecked raw subtraction without SafeMath.
transfer operates on the caller-controlled msg.sender balance.
transfer decrements balances[msg.sender] and increments balances[to].
The to parameter is used as the key into the balances mapping in transfer.
The tokens parameter drives the balance arithmetic in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd on balances[to].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient balance.
The from parameter of transferFrom is used as a balances key.
The to parameter of transferFrom is used as a balances key.
The tokens parameter of transferFrom is subtracted from the allowance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
The spender parameter becomes the target contract of the receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into receiveApproval.
The data parameter is forwarded into receiveApproval.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary contract.
The arbitrary spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall before its allowance state is settled.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token during the external transfer call.
The tokenAddress parameter determines the callee of the external transfer call.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the external transfer call.
onlyOwner on transferAnyERC20Token restricts execution to msg.sender == owner.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is the only input of transferOwnership and flows directly into the newOwner state variable.
The to parameter is consumed only by transfer as a balances key.
The tokens parameter is consumed only by transfer's SafeMath balance arithmetic.
The from parameter is consumed only by transferFrom for balance and allowance updates.
The to parameter is consumed only by transferFrom for the recipient balance update.
The tokens parameter is consumed only by transferFrom's SafeMath operations.
The spender parameter is the arbitrary callee of the receiveApproval external call.
The tokens parameter is passed as an argument to the receiveApproval external call.
The data parameter is passed as an argument to the receiveApproval external call.
The tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract receiving the external transfer call.
The tokens parameter is passed as an argument to the external transfer call.
